guide.title: 参与前安全检查
guide.description: 核对官方域名后再操作。请使用专用的独立空投钱包，任何时候都不要输入助记词或私钥。任何要求你输入助记词、私钥或向个人地址转账的页面都是骗局。
guide.done_when: 已确认官方域名，并准备好专用的独立空投钱包。

guide.title: 加入 Catalyst 等候名单
guide.description: 访问 Catalyst 网站并使用你的邮箱注册。在可选字段中添加你的 X 账号，以便团队可以将你的帐户链接到社交活动。
guide.done_when: 页面显示该步骤已完成 / 状态已更新。
guide.original_description: Go to the Catalyst website and sign up with your email. Add your X handle in the optional field so the team can link your account to social activity.

guide.title: 分享你的等候名单链接
guide.description: 如果等候名单在注册后为你提供了分享链接，请将其发布在 X 上或发送给进行交易的朋友。邀请可能会让你在排队中排名靠前。邀请奖励尚未公布。
guide.done_when: 页面显示该步骤已完成 / 状态已更新。
guide.original_description: If the waitlist gives you a share link after sign-up, post it on X or send it to friends who trade. Invites may move you up the queue. Referral rewards have not been announced.

guide.title: 加入催化剂 Discord
guide.description: 加入 Catalyst Discord 并介绍自己。在社区渠道中分享贸易想法或市场论文，因为这是产品构建的输入类型。
guide.done_when: 页面显示该步骤已完成 / 状态已更新。
guide.original_description: Join the Catalyst Discord and introduce yourself. Share trade ideas or market theses in the community channels, since that is the kind of input the product is built around.

guide.title: 关注 Discord 角色
guide.description: 还没有角色。检查公告频道以了解角色启动、早期测试人员电话或贡献者计划，并在任何角色开放后立即领取。
guide.done_when: 页面显示该步骤已完成 / 状态已更新。
guide.original_description: There are no roles yet. Check the announcements channel for role launches, early tester calls or contributor programs, and claim any role as soon as it opens.

guide.title: 接受你的测试版邀请
guide.description: 访问权限批量打开。当你收到邀请时，登录并设置你的钱包。
guide.done_when: 页面显示该步骤已完成 / 状态已更新。
guide.original_description: Access opens in batches. When your invite arrives, sign in and set up your wallet.

sourcedDescription: Catalyst has not announced a token, points program or airdrop. There is no ticker, and the “tokens” on its site refer to assets you can trade. The case for a potential Catalyst airdrop rests on the profile: a $30M raise from crypto-native investors, a product that trades onchain assets and a private beta that rewards early users with access first.
